recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a male musician with curly hair, wearing a plaid shirt and holding an electric guitar, set against a weathered brick alleyway. The composition features a strong contrast between the sharp subject and a blurred, gritty background, with stylized, hand-drawn white typography layered over the left side.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third, looking directly at the camera.
Guitar neck creates a diagonal leading line from the bottom left toward the subject.
Typography occupies the negative space of the blurred alleyway on the left.
Warm skin tones and wood textures contrast with the cool, desaturated brick and concrete.
coreInvariants: Shallow depth of field focusing on the subject's face.
Hand-drawn, marker-style lettering for the primary text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-close-up, occupying the right 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright wood of the guitar body.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the shoulder down to the guitar, then moves left across the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame provides a blurred, textured background for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated earth tones (brick reds, grays, browns) in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the typography to ensure legibility against the dark alley.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blue denim and warm yellow-orange wood of the guitar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and dark background; moderate saturation in the subject's clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant synthetic colors.
Maintain a natural, slightly desaturated film-like grade.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weights mimicking a felt-tip marker.
Intentional misalignment of characters to create a 'hand-written' feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' and 'D' have exaggerated, open loops.
Horizontal strokes are often angled or slightly curved.

treatment.outline: Thin black drop shadow for lift

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent hand-drawn style across different weights and scales.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow on text to separate it from the complex background.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, felt-tip stroke quality.
Provides the structured but informal feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photograph of a man with curly hair in a plaid shirt holding a guitar, sitting in a gritty brick alleyway. Use a shallow depth of field so the background bricks are blurred. Lighting should be natural and slightly overcast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, marker-style white lettering in the left-center negative space. Use a large, bold weight for the primary name and a smaller, thinner weight for the title below it. Add a subtle black drop shadow to the text.

verificationChecks: Text is legible against the background.
Subject remains the focal point despite the large text.
The 'hand-drawn' quality of the text feels authentic, not digital.

adjustableVariables: Degree of 'jitter' in the hand-drawn lettering
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any specific brand logos on the guitar or clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check that the guitar neck points toward the subject's face.
Ensure the white text has enough contrast against the gray/red bricks.
Verify the curly hair texture is sharp and well-defined.
Confirm the plaid shirt colors are grounded and not neon.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Musician) + Prop(Instrument) + Setting(Gritty Urban) + Style(Hand-drawn Typography) = Modern Country Aesthetic
